MemeDef.label: seafaring
MemeDef.description: The sea is our true home and lifeblood. To live away from open waters is to be severed from our purpose.

rulesStrings.li: creation(tag=meme_MVO_Seafaring) ->[deity0_name] parted the primordial land and birthed the vast ocean, placing the first crew upon the tide.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_MVO_Seafaring) ->The crew weathered a hurricane under [deity0_name]'s gaze, learning that stability on land is a false promise.
intro(tag=meme_MVO_Seafaring) ->On the waters of [place_name], [founderName] built the first sea vessel and abandoned the dust of dry land.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_MVO_Seafaring) ->Listening to the waves against the hull late at night, I realized that
lesson(tag=meme_MVO_Seafaring) ->land binds the soul, but the sea sets it free
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_MVO_Seafaring) ->If you stay too long on the ground, your spirit turns to stone.
